Best secondary URLs found: https://discoveryalert.com.au/japan-semiconductor-export-controls-2026/ and an X post https://x.com/Teo_Sinamin/status/2084465044096733459 ; Chambers 'International Trade 2026 - Japan' guide (https://practiceguides.chambers.com/practice-guides/international-trade-2026/japan) may also discuss it. Treat dates and scope as unverified pending METI 改正情報 confirmation.
actor: Japan Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI)
source_title: Japan Semiconductor Export Controls: What They Mean
verify_note: discoveryalert.com.au returned 403 (blog aggregator, not primary). Only weak secondary support found: search summaries and an X post stating METI revised the FEFTA list on 2026-05-29 adding advanced-packaging equipment ('third round'), effective 2026-08-01. No METI, Reuters or Nikkei primary located. Treat as unverified; replace with METI notice before relying on it.
